property_summary: For any inputs to initialize, the contract's stored changeFee equals the _changeFee argument (i.e., c.changeFee() == _changeFee); the mutant increments and thus will produce c.changeFee() != _changeFee for some fuzzed inputs.
change_summary: Replace storing of changeFee with storing of changeFee + 1 (increment) so initialized changeFee differs by +1.
